function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT period,
       SUM(amount_cad) AS total_amount_cad,
       SUM(qty) AS total_qty,
       SUM(amount_cad) / SUM(qty) AS avg_cost_per_unit_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period","purpose":"Compute average purchase cost per unit (CAD) for Aug and Sep 2026."}
